title: The Pinata Endurance Challenge! III
description: The Pinata Endurance Challenge! III — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_B

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy 8 Pinatas and Slay 2 Hero Gladiator in the Pinata Endurance Challenge off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratstpuin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: QuestGiver_B

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Destroy 8 Pinatas and Slay 2 Hero Gladiator in the Pinata Endurance Challenge off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratstpuin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Those Hero Gladiators must really be getting on your nerves! Well, you gotta do what you gotta do, at least that's what my mum always says. Only, she says that about the chores I have to do, but I think it make sense here too. Like destroying Pinatas and slaying Hero Gladiators is kind of like chores. Coolest chores ever!

Go to the entrance to the Pinata Invitational off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag, destroy eight Pinatas, and slay two Hero Gladiators. When you are done with that you should return to me, the Excited Lad, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

This is great! The Hero Gladiators are starting to send hand written letters of apology to you. Oh well, too little too late. You ready to try this quest again?

Objectives:

  • Destroy Pinatas
  • Slay Hero Gladiators

Client level range: 85–89
